# Changelog

## Server Waypoint 4.0.1

A patch release: less server lag when players join or change dimension, cheaper navigation-item checks, and map-mod waypoints that reappear after you reconnect.

### Before you update

- 4.0.1 uses the same network protocol as 4.0.0, so 4.0.0 and 4.0.1 clients, servers and Velocity proxies work together. Update the client mod for the map-mod fixes and servers for the rest.

### Performance

- `/wp list` and `/wp remote` add about 86% fewer nodes to the command list that Minecraft rebuilds and sends when a player joins, changes dimension or has their permissions changed. Building that list stalled some servers for several seconds ([#35](https://github.com/2676959/server_waypoint/issues/35)). The options and their suggestions are unchanged, but an invalid `sort`, `order` or `view` value is now reported when the command runs rather than while you type.
- On Paper and Folia, navigation-item checks read item data directly instead of building Bukkit item metadata, and queued inventory checks for the same player merge into one.
- On Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, inventory clicks skip navigation-item cleanup unless a navigation item is involved, and the checks no longer copy item data.
- `/wp list` searches and command suggestions use less memory with large waypoint sets.
- Xaero's Minimap no longer rewrites every server waypoint on each respawn and dimension change.

### Navigation

- Item protection now checks only the navigation compass or map itself. Bundles, shulker boxes and other containers are no longer searched for them, and anything already inside stays. Putting a navigation item into a bundle or an open shulker box is still blocked.
- On Paper and Folia, items that hoppers and other blocks move between containers are no longer checked for navigation items.
- On Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, allays and dropped items are no longer scanned every tick. Giving a navigation item to an allay is still blocked, and dropped navigation items are still removed.

### Fixes

- VoxelMap and Xaero's Minimap restore server waypoints when you rejoin a server whose waypoints haven't changed. In 4.0.0 they could stay missing until a waypoint changed or you used **Sync now**. Automatic syncs also wait until the map mod has loaded the current world.
- On Paper and Folia, a navigation item can no longer be put into an empty bundle.

# Changelog

## Server Waypoint 4.0.0

A major release: navigation that works without the client mod, waypoint icons, uploads from map mods, VoxelMap support, cross-server waypoints through Velocity, and redesigned commands and screens.

### Before you update

- **Update servers and clients together.** 4.0.0 changes the network protocol and doesn't sync with 3.x. Use matching builds on Velocity and every participating backend too.
- **`/wp edit` has a new syntax.** It changes one property at a time: `/wp edit waypoint <dimension> <list> <waypoint> set <property> [<value>]`, or `clear <property>` for an optional one. The 3.x form that took every property at once is gone, so update command blocks and scripts that use it. `/wp add` still accepts its 3.x syntax.
- **Paper now applies the `CommandPermission` levels.** In 3.x, players without an explicit permission node needed operator status. They now get the level set in `config.json`, so with the defaults every player can use `/wp add`, `/wp edit`, `/wp remove` and `/wp navigate`. To limit these to operators again, set their levels to 2 or deny the nodes in your permission plugin.
- **Xaero's Minimap sets synced by 3.x stay behind.** By default, Server Waypoint now marks the sets it creates and changes only those. Sets synced by 3.x have plain list names, so they remain next to the new ones as your own sets. Delete them in Xaero's Minimap if you don't need them.
- **Direct sync into Xaero's Default set is optional and off by default.** Turning on **Sync into Xaero's default set** makes syncing the server list `gui.xaero_default` replace that set's contents, including personal waypoints. Leave it off to use a separate server-owned set.
- **Custom translation files need updating.** Most server message keys were renamed, so language files made for 3.x no longer override them. Start a new file from the 4.0.0 `en_us.json`.
- **Choose the Paper JAR for your Minecraft version.** The ranges are now 1.21–1.21.8, 1.21.9–1.21.10, 1.21.11 plus 26.1–26.1.2, and 26.2–26.3. The new 1.21.9 build provides native chat icons.
- **NeoForge 1.21.6 and 1.21.7–1.21.8 have separate JARs.** Select the download for your exact version range.
- Waypoint files, `config.json` and client settings from 3.x load as they are.

### Navigation

- `/wp navigate <dimension> <list> <waypoint>` guides you to a waypoint with a compass, a map, the boss bar, the action bar or a floating label. It runs on the server, so it works without the client mod.
- `/wp navigate` shows your target and switches methods on and off. `/wp navigate config text_display` moves, turns and resizes the floating label.
- `defaultNavigationMethods` in `config.json` chooses the methods a new session starts with (default: `actionbar`). `CommandPermission.navigate` sets who can navigate (default: level 0).
- Navigation resumes when you rejoin, and the compass, map and label follow edits to the waypoint.
- Navigation maps remember explored terrain when you change targets or regions. Returning to a previously visited region restores its terrain, including after a server restart; unexplored regions start blank.
- Compass and map tooltips show the waypoint and dimension with clearer formatting.

### Waypoints

- Choose an item or a VoxelMap image as a waypoint's icon. Icons appear on in-world markers and in the waypoint manager. Supported VoxelMap images also sync to VoxelMap; item icons use its default waypoint image.
- Waypoints have an optional display name, keywords and description. Lists can have a display name too.
- `/wp remove` answers with a Restore link that works once within 10 minutes.

### Commands

- `/wp` opens a menu: most features are a click away, and each reply links to the next steps. `/wp help [<topic>]` explains every command with usages you can click and examples.
- The console, RCON and command blocks get the same information as plain text.

...

## Server Waypoint 3.0.4

Maintenance and compatibility release.

### Fixes
- Fixed waypoint cache handling when switching servers through proxies such as Velocity(mentioned in #30).
- Saved pending waypoint changes before proxy transfers and cleared stale server cache state.
- Fixed waypoint rendering and build compatibility for Minecraft 26.2.

### Translations
- Added Traditional Chinese, Hong Kong Chinese, Spanish, and Hebrew translations.
- Improved language file loading with case-insensitive locale handling.
